verdict.rationale: Steel is a browser-automation infrastructure API for agents/developers, not itself an interface that accepts natural-language commands from a user; the CLI (steel-docs-8) is a scriptable command-line tool with structured commands, not NL input, and no evidence shows a chat/NL interface for operating Steel directly. missing for 10: any documented NL command interface, chatbot/assistant front-end, or evidence that end users type plain-English instructions to control Steel.
